bio.text: Adelita Grijalva represents Arizona's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
She grew up in Tucson, graduated from Pueblo High School, and earned a political science degree from the University of Arizona.
First elected in 2002 to the Tucson Unified School District Governing Board, she was elected to the Pima County Board of Supervisors in 2020 and served as its Chair.
She worked at Pima County Teen Court for more than 25 years and lives in Tucson.
